text_block_list.text:
I went out shopping with Yaeno Muteki 
today. The city is completely decked out 
for Christmas and bustling everywhere.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
It is almost Christmas, is it not? I am 
reminded of it each year by the 
decorations around town.
choice_data_list:
So you're not doing anything special for 
Christmas?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Not particularly on my own. Though I do 
sometimes join the banquets at the academy 
or dorms.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I only learned about the custom of gift 
exchanges at the dorm banquet.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
That is lovely. No matter what the gift 
may be, all is well as long as everyone 
can share a laugh together.
choice_data_list:
What kind of Christmases did you have back 
home?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
It was quite simple. We'd decorate the 
tree, and have roast chicken for dinner. 
Oh, and we ate cake, too.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: As for a gift...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer-dono, did you know? Santa Claus 
only gives presents to good children.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Therefore, Santa never came to me.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
To be precise, it did not come "at 
Christmas."

text_block_list.name: Young Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
………………The stocking was empty... Even 
though I was a good girl...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki's Grandfather
text_block_list.text:
Maybe for the past few days. But what 
about last week? What about last month?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki's Grandfather
text_block_list.text:
Santa was watching Yaeno's conduct at all 
times. Therefore, if I correct my ways, 
eventually Santa will deliver my present.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...After that, I devoted myself diligently 
to practice, and a few days later, a gift 
arrived.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Santa was watching me, and if I corrected 
my foolish behavior, I'd receive a gift. 
That sense of fulfillment was truly 
profound—

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...Hmm, thinking back on it now, perhaps 
it was my ego being satisfied by 'being 
acknowledged by Santa.'

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
If I had received gifts as a matter of 
course, I likely never would have thought 
to devote myself to practice.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Having not been acknowledged as a good kid 
before, the joy of finally being 
recognized was all the sweeter.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...Did Grandpa see through to my true 
desires even back then...?

"The incident with the Christmas present 
has contributed to Yaeno Muteki's growth. 
There's no doubt about that, but..."

"Never having received a gift from Santa 
Claus on Christmas Day felt a little 
lonely, I thought—"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Hello, Yaeno's Trainer. Did you need 
something from me?
choice_data_list: Actually, I want to be your Santa, Yaeno.

text_block_list.text:
"I want to deliver a present from Santa 
Claus to the hard-working Yaeno Muteki."

To carry out the plan, I decided to ask 
Fuji Kiseki, the Ritto dorm leader, for 
her help. I gave her a brief summary of 
what happened the other day.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...I see. Yeah, sounds great! I'm all for 
it!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
So your request for me is... let me guess, 
you want me to deliver a Christmas Eve 
present to Yaeno?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Speaking of presents from Santa, it's 
tradition for them to be in the stocking 
by your pillow when you wake up in the 
morning, after all!

Since I can't enter the Ritto Dormitory, I 
had no choice but to ask someone in the 
dorm to leave the present in the middle of 
the night.

I do have one concern, though... Since 
Yaeno Muteki is a martial artist, her 
intuition is sharp.

I tell her that even while asleep, she 
might still sense someone sneaking into 
the room.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, leave that to me! To tell you the 
truth, I'm actually quite good at magic 
tricks.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"If we set up the surprise while Yaeno's 
away, I think we can make sure she finds 
her present on Christmas morning!"
choice_data_list:
Really!? In that case, do you mind if I 
ask you to?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Of course! For such a wonderful surprise, 
I'd be more than happy to help!
And on Christmas morning—

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Good morning, Trainer-dono.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Um... thank you very much for the 
Christmas gift.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
It's a gift. Did you prepare this for me, 
Trainer...?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Ah! I deduce that the original plan was to 
put it inside the sock to surprise you.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
However... after dinner yesterday, I ended 
up finding it under my bed...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
If only that dropped pencil hadn't rolled 
under the bed...!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I am deeply, truly sorry!! To have made 
all of Fuji-san and Trainer-dono's 
consideration come to naught... It is of 
the utmost regret...!

If we got discovered purely by chance, it 
can't be helped. I feel bad for Fuji 
Kiseki after she went out of her way to 
help us, though.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
“Um... it really made me happy, though. 
Naturally the gift did, but—”

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
The fact that you went to such great 
lengths for my sake, Trainer-dono.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu, excuse me. I just couldn't help 
but smile...

Though the surprise fell flat, Yaeno 
Muteki seemed delighted nonetheless!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Good morning, Trainer-dono!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Look at this!! I have received a gift from 
Santa!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
When I woke up this morning, this was 
right by my pillow!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
It was inside my stocking, so I wondered 
if it might be a gift from Santa!
choice_data_list:
You got it because you're such a good 
girl, Yaeno!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I knew it! ...Though I'm still a little 
curious about who Santa really is...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Let's put that aside for now.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"Finally... Santa has finally recognized 
me as a good girl...!"

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Ah! I want to convey this joy, this 
gratitude to Santa as well...!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
However, trying to uncover Santa's true 
identity would be rather tactless.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... If I put a thank-you letter in a 
sock and leave it out, will it reach them, 
I wonder...?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Alright, let's do that!

The surprise was a complete success, and 
Yaeno Muteki seemed overjoyed!

Later on, I received a thank-you letter 
from Yaeno Muteki through Fuji Kiseki.
